title: CoinRun selected-mixture dynamics fixed-20k scale sweep
question: On the PPO-checkpoint mixture selected by CR-DYN-0008, how does CoinRun dynamics rollout quality change from 0.16M to 12.90M parameters at fixed 20,000 updates?
reason: The previous scale curve used a small tokenizer, random-action data and the wrong action contract. Capacity should be re-measured with the 16.6M EMA tokenizer and the checkpoint mixture selected by a complete fixed-record ablation rather than hard-coding final-policy-only data.
hypothesis: With corrected representation, action semantics and selected PPO-mixture data, held-out mean-frame PSNR and SSIM improve from tiny to small to medium; the large model should at least match medium under equal 20,000-update budgets.
falsification: Reject the monotonic scale hypothesis if small does not exceed tiny, medium does not exceed small, or large falls below medium on either mean-frame PSNR or mean SSIM.

constants.training_mixture_selection: CR-DYN-0008 frozen lexicographic rule after all three arms complete

source.source_freeze: Execution code is frozen at d22b38b7a774b407777e47c4a95ad120ea7596ed. CR-DYN-0009 starts only after CR-DYN-0008 writes a valid complete-arm selection artifact.

data.provenance: The exact train corpus, source checkpoint counts and tree hash are fixed by the valid CR-DYN-0008 selection artifact before any CR-DYN-0009 non-reused arm starts.

compute.estimated_budget: Tiny, small and large 20k arms run serially after CR-DYN-0008; the selected medium arm is reused, approximately 8-14 additional A10-hours.
compute.shutdown_policy: One existing A10 only, no concurrent training. Preserve OOM or instability as a failed arm instead of silently changing batch size, updates or architecture.

selection_dependency.rule: Descending mean-frame PSNR, then descending mean SSIM, then descending horizon-16 PSNR, then mixture name.

training.medium_reuse: Reuse the byte-identical selected-mixture medium arm from CR-DYN-0008.

success_criteria.rule: CR-DYN-0008 must have all three completed medium arms, a valid corpus audit and a frozen selection artifact before CR-DYN-0009 starts.
All four scale points use the exact selected mixture, 16.6M EMA tokenizer, batch size, optimizer recipe, 20,000 updates and fixed held-out futures.
Every non-reused arm starts from scratch and reaches checkpoint step 19,999; OOM or instability remains visible as a failed arm.
Support monotonic scaling only if tiny < small < medium <= large for both mean-frame PSNR and mean SSIM.
